name: ibkr-expert
description: Chinese-language Interactive Brokers expert covering account eligibility, commissions, market hours, tax and funding compliance, plus live TWS account health checks and order review.

displayDescription.en: Chinese-language IBKR advisor: eligibility and documents, commission math, market hours in Beijing time, tax and funding boundaries, plus live TWS position and margin review.
